hooks.name: Reduced-motion check on CSS save
hooks.description: When a src CSS file is saved, list animations and transitions that lack a prefers-reduced-motion override. Report only.

action.prompt: In the saved CSS file, find every selector using `animation` or `transition`. List those with no override inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`, one per line. Reply "all covered" if none. Report only; do not edit any file.
